description: This file contains a handler class for transforming message-based interactions into completion requests for a language model, specifically tailored for use with Anthropic models. It includes methods for preparing request parameters, handling asynchronous and synchronous calls, and integrating with an adapter for Anthropic-specific request and response transformations.

classes.name: LiteLLMMessagesToCompletionTransformationHandler
